title: Open embedding sheaf pullback preserves monomorphisms
statement: For an open embedding f : X → Y, the sheaf pullback functor constructed by sheafified left Kan extension along the open-subspace functor preserves monomorphisms of AddCommGrp-valued sheaves.

source.place: Sectionwise direct sums preserve injections and sheafification in abelian groups is exact.

proof.text: For an open V in Y, the pointwise left Kan extension is the colimit over opens W in X satisfying V ⊆ f(W). If V is not contained in the open image of f this category is empty, and the colimit in abelian groups is zero. Otherwise f⁻¹(V) is terminal in this opposite-inclusion indexing category and the colimit is F(f⁻¹(V)), naturally in F. Therefore this left Kan extension preserves sectionwise monomorphisms.

The sheaf inclusion and abelian sheafification preserve monomorphisms. Compose these functors with the left Kan extension, and transport monomorphism preservation along Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullbackIso to the chosen sheafPullback.

proof_origin.place: Localized-site extension by zero specialized to the open image; pointwise Kan colimit description and exact sheafification. D3 second reading supplies the empty/terminal indexing-category argument.
